about.title: From Physical Therapy to software engineering for healthcare
about.p1: I'm a Mid-level Full Stack Developer building scalable solutions with React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript and Go. I focus on process automation, digital transformation, high performance and system stability.
about.p2: Today I work at Mobilemed Soluções Médicas, supporting critical teleradiology systems: I investigate complex production bugs, optimize databases and modernize legacy code. Before that, I led development at Biointegral Saúde, where I built an e-commerce platform from scratch plus financial and patient-flow systems, cutting operating costs by 15% and doubling the team's productivity.
about.p3: I come from Physical Therapy, which gave me empathy for the people who use the product, technical leadership and attention to detail. I have international experience and speak English (C1) and French (B2), which makes working with global teams easier.
about.softSkills: Technical leadership · Problem solving · Software quality · Communication · Scrum · Kanban

biointegral.description: Technical leadership in the development of financial management and patient-flow systems, a high-performance e-commerce platform built from scratch and automations that reduced operating costs by 15%, working with global teams. Technologies: React.js, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Go and PostgreSQL.
